Feature: Supports AXI Protocol on Host Master Interface and AHB for CSR Programming with 32 -bit data width.
Test Description: Basic USB register-access smoke test that reads from two control/status locations, writes a test pattern to another location, reads it back, logs values, and exits cleanly.
Meta Test Description: The C program prints a hello banner, performs register read operations from 0xA0000000 and 0xa001706c, logs both values, writes 0xdeadbeef to 0xA0240000, reads back from 0xA0240000 and logs the value, then calls finish(0) to end the test.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Initialize the test and log the start banner. 2) Read and log data from a first USB CSR location. 3) Read and log data from a second USB CSR location. 4) Write a known test pattern to a USB CSR location, then read back and log the value. 5) Exit the test cleanly if no errors are observed.
Meta Test Steps / Procedure:
1) printf("[C-Programme] Hello world
"); 2) int rd_data = 0; 3) rd_data = read_reg(0xA0000000); 4) printf("THE READ DATA is %X
", rd_data); 5) rd_data = read_reg(0xa001706c); 6) printf("THE READ DATA1 is %X
", rd_data); 7) write_reg(0xA0240000, 0xdeadbeef); 8) rd_data = read_reg(0xA0240000); 9) printf("THE READ DATA2 is %X
", rd_data); 10) finish(0);
Validation / Acceptance Criteria: Pass if the program completes without error (finish(0) reached) and register read/write operations produce log outputs as expected.
Meta Validation / Acceptance Criteria: There are no explicit asserts or comparisons. Success is implied by uninterrupted execution to finish(0) after performing read_reg at 0xA0000000 and 0xa001706c, write_reg to 0xA0240000 with 0xdeadbeef, and subsequent read_reg from 0xA0240000 with corresponding printf logs.

Test Description: USB host low-speed enumeration via xHCI: initialize controller, configure event/command rings and contexts, reset the root port, enable a slot and address the device, then perform standard EP0 control transfers (GET/SET CONFIG) and confirm completions through interrupts/event ring before clean exit.
Meta Test Description: The test initializes NIC and enables all IRQs, programs GCTL/GFLADJ/GUCTL, sets PIPE and PHY control at MIZAR_USB_BASE+0xc2c0 and +0xc200, reads capability and port registers (HCSPARAMS1, SUPTPRT2_DW2, SUPTPRT3_DW2, PORTSC_20), enables wake/overcurrent events on PORTSC_20 and writes 0xe0002a0. It reads DBOFF, programs the Event Ring Segment Table (base, size), reads HCSPARAMS2 and PAGESIZE, sets Scratchpad Buffer Array entries, loads the Device Context Base Address Array, programs Command Ring Control (CRCR_LO/HI), writes CONFIG (0x10 then 0x110), sets DCBAAP_LO/HI, ERSTSZ, ERDP_LO/HI, ERSTBA_LO/HI, IMOD, IMAN, enables interrupts via USBCMD (0x4) and system register INTR_EN0, then starts the controller (USBCMD=0x5). It waits for an interrupt (int_pend cleared by ISR), acknowledges USBSTS and re-enables IMAN, advances ERDP, reads PORTSC_20, increments ERDP_LO, performs a port reset sequence via PORTSC_20 (0xe0006f1, 0xe220200), waits for interrupt again. It submits an Enable Slot command TRB on Default_Command_Ring and acknowledges events (USBSTS/IMAN/ERDP updates), rings the doorbell (DB=0x0), waits for interrupt, then prepares an Input Context for EP0 and submits Address Device command TRBs (0x01002e01, then 0x01002c01) with ERDP advances and DB writes, each time waiting for interrupts and reading completion entries from Default_Event_Ring_Array (0x30, 0x40). It then calls enumeration(), which builds EP0 control transfer TRBs: GET DESCRIPTOR (device), GET CONFIGURATION, SET CONFIGURATION, further GET CONFIGURATIONs, places data buffers via EP0_TR_Dequeue_Pointer offsets, rings the controller via MIZAR_USB_BASE+0x484, and polls Default_Event_Ring_Array+0x110 until non-zero. On success it calls finish(0). The ISR (Default_IRQHandler) reads MSK_STS0 and RAW_STCR0, if bit 31 is set it writes IMAN=0x1 and clears RAW_STCR0 bit 31, then clears GIC IRQ 84.
Remarks: A USB device must be connected to the root hub port for enumeration. External interrupts must be enabled and routable so that INTR_EN0 and IMAN signaling can be serviced. Controller must accept doorbell writes (DB) during command and transfer submissions.
Test Steps / Procedure: 1) Initialize the NIC and enable CPU interrupts for USB. 2) Configure global controller settings and PHY/PIPE controls. 3) Read USB capabilities and configure the port to enable wake/overcurrent events. 4) Initialize event ring structures and sizes, and set the dequeue pointer. 5) Configure scratchpad buffers and the device context base address array. 6) Initialize the command ring, set configuration, program DCBAAP, and enable interrupts. 7) Start the controller and wait for an interrupt; acknowledge status and re-arm interrupts. 8) Reset and enable the root port, update dequeue pointers, and wait for the port change interrupt. 9) Issue an Enable Slot command, advance the event ring, and re-arm interrupts. 10) Build the input context for EP0, issue Address Device commands, ring the doorbell, and wait for completions. 11) Perform EP0 control transfers to retrieve descriptors and set configuration; ring as needed and confirm completions via the event ring. 12) Confirm all required completions are received and exit the test cleanly.
